mapper.sql: event_id, title, description, location, event_date, pinned, hidden, publish_date, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM event ORDER BY pinned DESC, event_date DESC
SELECT FROM event WHERE hidden = FALSE AND publish_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY pinned DESC, event_date ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event (title, description, location, event_date, pinned, publish_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{eventDate}, #{pinned}, #{publishDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE event SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, location = #{location}, event_date = #{eventDate}, pinned = #{pinned}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
